# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and GTK4 GPU** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 and a native GTK4 GPU canvas. Linux NoDependencies font discovery is restored. WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11, and the Tizen packages now require Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64.

## Breaking Changes

- **GTK4 raster painting defaults to physical pixels** — SKDrawingArea now allocates full-resolution backing on high-density displays and reports physical CanvasSize and paint Info by default. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true for logical paint coordinates while retaining physical backing resolution; GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Tizen 10 is required** — New Tizen native builds and packages support Tizen 10 on x64 and arm64 only; Tizen 8/9 and the old 32-bit paths are unsupported. Move applications to net10.0-tizen10.0. Source builds require the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2; device loading remains unvalidated. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to m156** — Advances the renderer without new managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 distinguishes the milestone package line while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — SKGLArea adds PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, EnableRenderLoop, and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns context lifetime; use QueueRender to invalidate and include libepoxy when bundling a GTK runtime. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies discovers installed fonts again** — Restores the directory-backed default font manager without adding fontconfig. The default scan uses /usr/share/fonts/ unless overridden at build time; a fontless directory retains the existing empty-family fallback. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **GTK4 raster storage released in ownership order** — Releases the Skia surface before Cairo-owned pixels and marks pixels dirty after channel swizzling. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly archives aligned** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 for net11+, retaining 3.1.34 for net8 and 3.1.56 for net9/net10. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

Aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly assets with Emscripten 6.0.2 and moves Tizen native packages to Tizen 10 on x64/arm64. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0; .100 is a package revision bucket.

Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and Tizen 10 packages.
